summary: The release of the Laya family of models by Convai Innovations marks a significant shift toward 'System 1' decision models. Unlike generative LLMs, Laya is a non-autoregressive model designed for high-speed, deterministic text classification and structured data extraction, making it ideal for production-critical tasks like email triage and guardrail enforcement.
title: System 1 AI: Why Convai Innovations' Laya Models are the Future of High-Speed Production Routing

summary: This article explores the architectural shift from using large autoregressive LLMs as judges to deploying specialized, non-autoregressive 'Decision Models' (like Jev and Kev) for local agentic workflows. By leveraging local hardware like the M5 Ultra Mac Studio, developers can achieve high-performance local execution for structured, typed decisions in agentic loops.
title: Beyond Autoregression: Deploying Decision Models for High-Frequency Agentic Guardrails

summary: An exploration of GraphRAG, a hybrid architecture combining graph databases with Retrieval-Augmented Generation to provide superior relational context and reduced hallucination in LLM applications.
title: Beyond Vector Search: Navigating the Rise of GraphRAG
